Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks for the follow-up questions. Below is a succinct mapping of procurement paths and recommended next steps so your team can evaluate internally. Happy to walk through on a call — proposed slot Mon 22 Feb 10:00 PST (per prior note).

1) PO vs Card / Billing flow
- Card: immediate on-demand access (hosted API). Good for short trials or small pilots.
- PO/Invoice (Net30): supported for direct Redwood contracts; we can accept POs and issue invoices Net30. For Marketplace purchases, billing is handled via AWS and some customers still issue POs to cover charges depending on their internal process.

2) Marketplace options
- Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace with a metered SaaS listing (metered usage) and with options for committing via a contract. If you prefer the marketplace cadence, we can engage Marketplace ops to provision. Marketplace is easiest for procurement but sometimes requires coordination for enterprise pricing/commits.

3) Deployment & pricing packaging (high-level)
- Hosted (Redwood API): on-demand; recommended for pilot. Pricing: pay-as-you-go or short-term commit (e.g., 30/60/90d) for a lower unit price during pilot.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): month-to-year commits; recommended for predictable throughput and data isolation. Pricing: reserved monthly commit with burst capacity options.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for strict network isolation / compliance. Typically part of an enterprise agreement with a platform fee + support.

4) Recommended pilot for FinTechCo
- Start hosted with a 60-day short commit to validate latency and integration (we can tier token commit to expected volume). If compliance requires, run a Dedicated pilot for 2–4 weeks to prove performance delta.

5) Compliance & artifacts
- SOC 2 type II and DPA are available — sharing links via secure drive (I asked Aditya to attach).
- For customer-managed keys and VPC we can provide a Private deployment plan; lead time depends on region and infra but typically 4–8 weeks for full on-prem/VPC rollout.

Attachments: updated pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (attached).

Next steps:

- Alex: confirm internal timeline for approvals and pilot start date. (Action: Alex)
- Dev / Redwood SEs: I’ll coordinate a short technical call to confirm pilot sizing if Procurement wants a Dedicated pilot. (Action: Marissa/Dev)
